title: Just Juice Bar Range Tropical Peach Saltfill Shortfill 40ml E-Liquid
description: Just Juice Tropical Peach Saltfill brings together juicy Peach and tangy Pineapple for a vibrant fruit blend. The sun-ripened sweetness of Peach pairs with Pineapple’s citrus edge, rounded off with a cool finish. Each Saltfill e-liquid comes in a 60ml bottle containing 40ml of concentrated flavour, leaving space for up to two 10ml nicotine shots. With a 60PG/40VG ratio, these e-liquids are designed to deliver sharp flavour with a tactile throat hit, making them an excellent choice for pod kits and starter devices. Just Juice Saltfills use double-concentrated flavouring for a bold and consistent taste experience, letting you enjoy your favourite profiles just the way you like them. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
